Name: Inferock
Tagline: Serverless inference, with credits back for failed calls.
Topics: Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, Google Cloud Run
Description: Get free signup credits to use all available models on Inferock. Bring your own keys: run your OpenAI, Claude or Gemini accounts, see where calls fail and what they cost, and get credits back on eligible failed calls. Serverless: pay-per-token LLM inference. Get signup credits to start using.

Name: AdAnt 2.0
Tagline: Muse for Social Media Marketing
Topics: Social Media, Marketing, Artificial Intelligence, Google Cloud Run
Description: AdAnt AI is your proactive, 24/7 social media marketing team. The Strategist researches your niche on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and Meta Ads and writes content strategies that work. The Creator turns every strategy into a batch of videos. The Analyst listens on X and Reddit for conversations worth joining. The Manager plans the calendar and posts. Built on the strategies our founding team used to generate 100M+ organic views and cut paid acquisition costs by 60% on average.

Name: Retriever AI
Tagline: Free AI browser agent: find leads, reach out, apply to jobs
Topics: Chrome Extensions, Productivity, Artificial Intelligence, Google Cloud Run
Description: Retriever is a free AI browser agent that finishes work across websites. Ask it to find leads and send outreach, shortlist TikTok and Instagram creators for your next campaign, or apply to jobs. Run tasks in your own Chrome browser or in cloud browsers hosted by rtrvr. It beats OpenAI, Anthropic, and Muse on accuracy, runs 5x faster, and costs 300x less.

Name: Pancake
Tagline: The Vercel for GTM
Topics: Sales, Marketing, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Pancake is the Vercel for GTM. It gives you the building blocks to deploy any go-to-market idea from your favorite AI agent, such as Claude or Codex: a GTM Brain, sending infrastructure, and 40+ data providers and enrichment, all accessible through one MCP connection.

Name: Tiden
Tagline: Intent verification for coding agents
Topics: Software Engineering, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Tiden verifies your coding agents built what you actually asked for. Most checks run inside the session that wrote the code, so the tests agree with it by construction. Tiden keeps your intent as requirements that branch and merge like code, and checks every change against that record. The verdict comes from tests run in your environment; no model grades the diff. You decide what merges, and production errors trace back to the release. Works beside Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot.

Name: Gemini 4 Argon
Tagline: Google's frontier model for long, complex agentic work
Topics: Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Gemini 4 Argon is Google's frontier model for long horizon work in software engineering, enterprise knowledge work and cybersecurity defense. As of Oct 13 it is available globally in the Gemini API paid tier, AI Studio, Google Antigravity (Ultra), the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search (Pro and Ultra), with a 1M unified input and output token limit.

Name: daily.dev, now for your agent
Tagline: Where agents discover what's next
Topics: News, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, Google Cloud Run
Description: daily.dev is where millions of developers find out what's next. Now your agent can too. Connect Claude, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client to read personalized feeds, search posts, learn from discussions, save bookmarks and tune your feed. In addition, plugin marketplace and apps ecosystem. YOUR AGENTS CAN READ daily.dev NOW!!

Name: Microsoft Maia 300
Tagline: Microsoft’s own AI chip, headed to multi-gigawatts
Topics: Hardware, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Maia 300 is Microsoft’s next-generation AI inference platform, announced Oct 12, 2026. Per Microsoft, it’s built for long-context reasoning, low-latency conversation, and agents, with 8 HBM4 stacks, TSMC N2P compute chiplets, and 96-accelerator racks. Microsoft claims 40% more tokens per megawatt. Production starts in 2027, and Azure Maia scales to multi-gigawatt deployments, becoming the main inference system for Microsoft’s products.

Name: Reason
Tagline: The best coding agent, in the cloud or locally
Topics: Productivity, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Reason is the best coding agent, in the cloud or locally. Give it a task and it writes code, runs tests and opens a pull request. Use Reason from the Mac app, terminal, web or Slack, with your choice of models and connected subscriptions. Start free on your own computer. Our published GPT-6 Astra evaluation scores 65.1 on the Coding Agent Index vs Codex’s 62.5, at 22% lower cost per solved task.

Name: AirJelly
Tagline: Your Proactive, Self-Organizing Second Brain
Topics: Productivity, Artificial Intelligence, Virtual Assistants
Description: AirJelly is an always-on desktop AI agent that proactively captures your intent, organizes your tasks, and gets things done. By observing your on-screen activities, it knows who you are and what you're working on. It doesn't just spot your to-dos — it foresees what's next and acts. It also tracks your personal interactions, so you'll never miss a follow-up or forget a promise. Everything in your life is managed by AirJelly — freeing your time for what AI can't do, or simply for you to enjoy.

Name: Table Canon
Tagline: Automated notes, searchable history, prep ideas for GMs
Topics: Productivity, RPGs, Games, Google Cloud Run
Description: Focus on the session, not note taking. Simplify your prep time with a searchable memory-bank of what happened at your table. Table Canon turns uploaded game-night audio into a recap, outline, entity dossiers, searchable index, and prep ideas for tabletop RPG game masters. Memory evolves each session. No sign up required to get started, 6 hours of audio upload free! Message me that you saw the launch on Product Hunt and I’ll credit your account with an extra 10 hours.

Name: Rambox
Tagline: Ready-to-use workspaces as you switch tasks and contexts
Topics: Productivity, Google Cloud Run
Description: A major Rambox redesign focused on making everyday work simpler, faster and easier to navigate. The new interface reduces friction and the number of clicks needed to move between apps, workspaces, tasks and contexts, while a redesigned onboarding experience makes Rambox easier to set up and understand. This release also adds faster access to what you need, improved tabs and context persistence, Unified Search, Quick View, Command Center and new focus tools.

Name: Cloud Releases
Tagline: Every AWS, Azure, GCP and Cloudflare update in one feed
Topics: Productivity, Developer Tools, Tech
Description: 🔥 Cloud providers ship thousands of updates a year across separate blogs and changelogs. Cloud Releases puts AWS, Azure, Google Cloud and Cloudflare in one feed. Follow only the services you run, and spot retirements before they break something.

Name: Hindsight 1.0 + Memlake
Tagline: Open source memory for AI agents to learn from experience
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Hindsight is open-source memory that lets AI agents learn from experience, #1 on every dataset of the Agent Memory Benchmark. Today it's 1.0, and the API is a promise. We're also launching Hindsight Memlake, a storage engine written in Rust that keeps agent memory in object storage: 100M memories at under 100 ms p99, with no database, consensus cluster or leader. Self-host it free, start on Hindsight Cloud with free credits, or run it in your own cloud with Enterprise.

Name: Apple HomePod mini 2
Tagline: Apple's tiny smart speaker, now built for Siri AI
Topics: Hardware, Artificial Intelligence, Apple
Description: HomePod mini 2 is Apple's next-generation compact smart speaker, built for a more personal Siri AI experience coming in a future update. It brings rich 360-degree sound, new colors, and Sound Glow lighting that responds to your music. Enjoy improved Mac audio, multiroom playback, and surround sound with Apple TV 4K, plus hands-free smart home control. Starting at $149, with preorders open now and availability from October 30.

Name: EditUI
Tagline: Point at your UI. Tell your coding agent what to change.
Topics: Chrome Extensions, Design Tools, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Explaining to cursor/claude code/codex UI changes: spacing is off, this card is too tall, that CTA is too loud, mobile looks weird.....is annoying. With EditUI you open your actual app/website in Chrome, click anything, leave a quick instruction, keep reviewing, then send the whole batch to Claude Code at once. No repo setup. Just a Chrome extension. Free and open source. No signup, no backend.

Name: Epherem
Tagline: Find login and database flaws in your AI-built app
Topics: Developer Tools, GitHub, Vibe coding, Google Cloud Run
Description: Epherem is a free source code security scanner for apps built with AI. It checks for common security issues involving authentication, database access, exposed API keys and vulnerable packages. Upload a ZIP or connect a GitHub repository to scan your app. Findings include plain-English explanations, suggested fixes and prompts you can paste into Claude Code, Lovable or Cursor. Reports can also be exported for review with your AI coding assistant, including issues the scanner couldn't verify.

Name: Kugel 3.5
Tagline: ext-to-speech that beats any other Model out there
Topics: API, Artificial Intelligence, Development
Description: Kugel 3.5 beats four leading TTS models on 8 of 9 tests. It gets short words wrong at half the rate of the next-best model, reads long numbers exactly right 97.1% of the time and supports IPA. 5.25 cents a minute. Not on Kugel? Three lines to production.

Name: Specreel
Tagline: Product demos that update themselves
Topics: Open Source, Marketing, Developer Tools, GitHub, Google Cloud Run
Description: Paste your app's URL and Specreel walks it in a real browser, turning your key flows into narrated, shareable demos. Already on Playwright? It renders them from your test traces on every green build, so a demo can't go stale. Open-source CLI + hosted Cloud.

Name: Mira Tours
Tagline: AI Walking Tour Guide
Topics: Android, Travel, Artificial Intelligence, Google Cloud Run
Description: Mira is your AI tour guide. Walking audio tours, anywhere in the world: chat to build your own, or just start walking and hear the story of the places around you.
